metadata.title: World Digest — November 2, 2026
metadata.summary: Daily Summary North Korea-linked hackers drained $4.6 billion from Binance in history's largest crypto heist, sending tech stocks down $1 trillion as AI-spending fears intensified.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

China overhauled cadre promotion rules to prioritize practical problem-solving, deepening its leadership purge South China Morning Post. Iran's Supreme Leader granted the government authority to manage Washington talks, easing oil supply fears Forex Factory. Belgium's prime minister resigned after budget talks collapsed; the king weighs acceptance Euronews.com AP News. In Israel, President Herzog began coalition consultations with smaller parties amid political deadlock Al Jazeera The Times of Israel.

Regional Flashpoints

Fake nuclear alerts hit Ukrainian and Russian emergency apps after hacks, as a localized ceasefire ended in Kherson BBC AP News. UN peacekeepers ended their 35-year Western Sahara mission NPR. Taiwan asserted maritime information sovereignty under Chinese pressure Reuters. Bulgaria elected its first female president Al Jazeera.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Global Markets Shakeout

Crypto exchange Binance saw over $4.6B in withdrawals following the largest hack in history, with the FBI blaming North Korea Yahoo Finance. Tech stocks tumbled, wiping out $1 trillion in value amid AI-spending fears Yahoo Finance, dragging Nasdaq to its worst day since June. Alphabet suffered its worst day ever Barron's. Crude plunged 4%+ on Iran peace talk hopes WSJ, while nine big oil firms are set to post $95B+ in quarterly profits The Guardian. Midterm election caution gripped European shares Reuters. Alstom shares sank 28% on a profit warning WSJ.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: Klara and the Sun director Taika Waititi called critics “sad lost souls” after the film’s box-office disaster The Guardian. Dave Bautista gained 20 pounds for his God of War role as Kratos Deadline. Marvel retconned Age of Ultron with VisionQuest The Direct. Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil reboot hit $400 million globally Variety. Mariah Carey declared “It’s time” for Christmas TODAY.com. Matt Damon and David Letterman made surprise Gilded Age cameos Deadline.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Football

Buffalo Bills 36, Baltimore Ravens 10 — Bills cruised in the second half, while Ravens lost QBs Lamar Jackson and Huntley to injuries, raising questions about Jackson's future in Baltimore ESPN ESPN.

Denver Broncos 28, Kansas City Chiefs 24 — Roach dropped Mahomes on fourth-and-goal, flipping the AFC West race ESPN.

Pittsburgh Steelers 27, Cleveland Browns 6 — Steelers took the AFC North lead and extended their home streak over Cleveland to 23 straight ESPN.

Cincinnati Bengals 43, Tennessee Titans 36 — Joe Burrow threw five TDs, then ran for the winning score in OT ESPN.

Baseball

Jerry Koosman, Miracle Mets' 1969 World Series hero, died at 83 — The lefty got the final out against Baltimore ESPN.

Basketball

Golden State Warriors 124, LA Clippers 112 — Rookie Lendeborg scored a career-high 37 without Curry and Green ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

OPay priced at $19 on NYSE Oct 30 Yahoo Finance. Aspen Neuroscience, Bambusa Therapeutics, Nordicus Partners listed on Nasdaq Oct 30 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Narragansett Bancorp set for Nasdaq Nov 2 Yahoo Finance; Deep Sea Minerals ADS follows Nov 3 Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

S&P 500 fell 1.82% to 7,580.07; Nasdaq dropped 2.86% to 25,437.00 Yahoo Finance. Dow slid 1.09%, Russell 2000 lost 1.66% Yahoo Finance. VIX spiked 12.91% to 19.42 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Tech led losses, down 4.89% Yahoo Finance. Energy gained 1.91% and Consumer Staples rose 1.41% as defensive bids emerged Yahoo Finance. Financials fell only 0.76%.

Major Stocks

Broadcom plunged 5.48%; Nvidia fell 4.22% Yahoo Finance. Apple, Microsoft, Meta each lost over 1% Yahoo Finance. Berkshire inched up 0.10% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Kenvue slipped 1.3% to $19.31 on heavy volume Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield dipped 1.20% to 4.93 Yahoo Finance. WTI crude jumped 2.08% to $104.12 Yahoo Finance. Gold dropped 3.29% to $3,898.90 Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin rose 1.05% to $78,248.45 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
24–48 hours: Watch Belgium’s coalition talks; king’s decision could trigger snap elections. Iran nuclear negotiations may move forward with Supreme Leader’s backing—oil prices likely volatile. Israel’s coalition consultations remain fluid.

Next week: Narragansett Bancorp debuts Nov 2, Deep Sea Minerals Nov 3. Crypto markets may stay shaky post-Binance hack. AI-sector selloff could deepen if Alphabet earnings fallout spreads.

Next month: Tech valuation reset may continue; energy earnings could offset losses. Monitor Chinese cadre policy effects on governance stability.
